items.name: liquid-tabs
items.title: Liquid tabs
items.description: Tabs whose highlight has a little surface tension: it draws out and pinches for a moment, then it is a pill again.

items.name: notification-bell
items.title: Notification bell
items.description: A bell that behaves like one: each notification hits it, a burst rings harder, and the clapper lags behind on its own.

items.name: folder
items.title: Folder
items.description: A project tile that holds your actual files: it opens on a hinge, fans real sheets, and takes a dropped file with weight.

items.name: reactions
items.title: Reactions
items.description: Emoji reactions for comments and messages: press, slide along the tray and let go, and the emoji flies into its chip.

items.name: voice-bar
items.title: Voice bar
items.description: A multimodal AI prompt and voice bar on a dither lattice: every word you say condenses out of the wave into the transcript, and the prompt grows line by line.

items.name: passkey-button
items.title: Passkey button
items.description: A biometric passkey button whose 9-ridge fingerprint scans optically ridge by ridge while pending, then sweeps an 8×8 Bayer wave across the pill as the ridges draw into a check.

items.name: dither-veil
items.title: Dither veil
items.description: A fine 8×8 Bayer privacy shield and secret field for API keys, signing secrets and balances: full-viewport optical veil, lazy on-demand fetch, copy-while-veiled and inherent edge-condensing auto-lock.

items.name: shortcut-recorder
items.title: Shortcut recorder
items.description: A tactile hairline keyboard shortcut recorder with physically depressed modifier keycaps, spring chord lock-in, layout-safe event.code capture and inline conflict swapping.

items.name: video-player
items.title: Video player
items.description: A hairline video player whose 3px scrubber springs open into a live filmstrip of extracted frames, with chapter micro-gaps, a return-to-spot bookmark and a Bayer buffering veil.

items.name: float
items.title: Float
items.description: A velocity-snapping floating container that projects throws into corners and tucks past the screen edge into a slim live hairline tab.

items.name: amount-field
items.title: Amount field
items.description: A hero auto-scaling money and credits input with spring typography scaling, a gliding velocity-stretch caret, smooth Max roll-up and live overdraft feedback.

items.name: page-outline
items.title: Page outline
items.description: A spring-guided hairline table of contents and collapsible reading progress pill whose active indicator glides smoothly along a continuous stepped SVG path.

items.name: voice-orb
items.title: Voice orb
items.description: Voice mode for your assistant: plasma in a glass globe that the voice moves, with the talk button, the microphone and the reply wired to your own backend.

items.name: light-writing
items.title: Light writing
items.description: A welcome that writes itself: one line of light writes the word, then bends into the next word or into your logo.

items.name: delete-undo
items.title: Delete with undo
items.description: One call on any element: it folds in half and in half again, turns edge-on and is gone. unfold() brings it back.

items.name: add-to-cart
items.title: Add to cart
items.description: One call throws the product into the cart on a real arc; it drops in below the rim and the cart dips with the weight.

items.name: spending-ring
items.title: Spending ring
items.description: Where the money went, and what is inside it: thick tiles with their amounts on them, and a category that blooms open into a ring of its own.

items.name: slide-to-send
items.title: Slide to send
items.description: The confirm step of a payment: carry the thumb to the person you are paying and the money drains into their avatar.

items.name: pay-button
items.title: Pay button
items.description: The button at the end of a checkout, through the whole wait: the card being charged, a line of light while it pays, and a receipt that slides out from under it.

items.name: camera-key
items.title: Camera key
items.description: The camera button of a call, built as a lens: seven aperture blades spiral open to show you and shut over you, so nobody wonders if their camera is on.

items.name: lens-bars
items.title: Lens bars
items.description: A whole year of days in one card, and a lens to read them: the bars under the pointer spread apart and widen, so any one day out of 365 is easy to land on.

items.name: threshold-line
items.title: Threshold line
items.description: Set an alert by seeing what it would have done: drag a line across the last 30 days and every day over it turns red while the count of alerts rolls.

items.name: compare-bars
items.title: Compare bars
items.description: This period, and with one press the one before: every bar splits in two, then what was gained turns green and what fell short shows in red.

items.name: share-bar
items.title: Share bar
items.description: Parts of a whole as one bar that comes apart into a ranked list: each segment drops out and slides into its own row, keeping its width.

items.name: range-brush
items.title: Range brush
items.description: Pick a stretch of days by holding it: a lit window over a year of hairlines that glides when thrown, stretches from either edge and settles on whole days.

items.name: tick-tape
items.title: Tick tape
items.description: Events as they happen, one hairline each: as tall as its latency, bright when it lands and cooling as it travels, with errors in red. Point at it to hold it still and read one.

items.name: pace
items.title: Pace
items.description: A goal for the month and whether you will make it: the running total climbs toward a goal line, the rest of the month is drawn at this pace, and the verdict says when.

items.name: dot-meter
items.title: Dot meter
items.description: Several goals at once, each a small field of dots that pours in like grains: protein, carbs and fat, or seats, storage and API calls.

items.name: balance-meter
items.title: Balance meter
items.description: What came in against what went out, and the net on a scale of hairline ticks whose needle swings and settles like a scale’s pointer.

items.name: liquid-log
items.title: Liquid log
items.description: The card is the vessel you log into: tap + and a drop falls into a live surface, the ripple runs to the walls, then the level rises.

items.name: live-qr
items.title: Live QR
items.description: A QR code that re-issues itself in place: only the tiles that change turn over, an expired code becomes its Refresh button, and a scan draws a check from its own tiles.

items.name: snowfall
items.title: Snowfall
items.description: Snow that settles on whatever you wrap: it caps your logo, packs into the gaps between its shapes, and a tap knocks it off.

items.name: tour-line
items.title: Tour line
items.description: A product tour drawn with one hairline frame: it draws itself round the first thing you’re shown, then glides and reshapes itself onto each next one, the card riding along.

items.name: streak-chain
items.title: Streak chain
items.description: “Don’t break the chain”, drawn big enough to care: today’s ring hangs open until you complete it, then it closes, fills with colour and the chain grows a ring.

items.name: signature-pad
items.title: Signature pad
items.description: Sign with ink that behaves like ink: it thickens where you slow down, dries in the order you wrote it, and clearing rewinds your strokes.

items.name: token-bucket
items.title: Token bucket
items.description: A rate limit you can watch refill: tokens grow at the real rate, requests take them, and waiting requests are carried off as each new one forms.

items.name: release-train
items.title: Release train
items.description: Your environments down a rail, each with the version it runs: promote one and a copy rides down to the next station, waits while it deploys, then docks.

items.name: time-overlap
items.title: Time overlap
items.description: Find a meeting time across time zones: each person’s day in hairline marks, a band you drag across everyone, and it settles into the hours you all share.

items.name: goal-tape
items.title: Goal tape
items.description: How far to free shipping, and the moment you get there: the fill runs into a satin ribbon stretched across the bar at the goal and bows it until it snaps.

items.name: lasso
items.title: Lasso
items.description: Select a loose group by drawing round it: let go and the band pulls tight like an elastic round exactly what it caught, bending in round what it didn’t.

items.name: stamp
items.title: Stamp
items.description: A definite “done” on any record, in ink: set it and the stamp lands with a press, the ink starts wet and dries into the grain, heavier where the pressure fell.

items.name: merge-button
items.title: Merge button
items.description: Merge a pull request and see it go in: the button carries a small branch graph, and pressing it draws what your merge strategy really does to main.

items.name: afterglow
items.title: Afterglow
items.description: Light runs through a card the moment something works: it rises from the button you pressed, the old content dissolves into the new behind it, and what changed catches the light.

items.name: status-capsule
items.title: Status capsule
items.description: A pill for something that takes a moment: a ring turns while it runs, and when it’s done a ribbon of light scans the pill and the words change under it.

items.name: hold-to-start
items.title: Hold to start
items.description: A card whose main action is held: light gathers toward your finger while you hold, and bursts across the card when it starts.

items.name: level-dial
items.title: Level dial
items.description: A 270° dial for one level in a card: drag it and it follows, and when a preset sets it a crest of light spreads from its centre as the arc sweeps there.

items.name: scene-mixer
items.title: Scene mixer
items.description: A few levels and the scenes that set them: press a scene and a soft veil of light drifts across the card while every level glides to its place.

items.name: pillar-chart
items.title: Pillar chart
items.description: A period of activity as glass pillars on dark lacquer: point at one and it turns white, switch the range and the new pillars rise in a wave.

items.name: stage-timeline
items.title: Stage timeline
items.description: A session as stages over time on dark lacquer, with a dot-matrix clock that turns to the time under your finger as you scrub.

items.name: track-player
items.title: Track player
items.description: A small lacquered player: the disc turns, the waveform ripples and fills as it plays, and changing track drifts a veil of light across it.

items.name: mist-reveal
items.title: Mist reveal
items.description: The calm wait for a generated image: fog drifts through the frame while it works, then the mist moves off and the picture sharpens into place.

items.name: grain-reveal
items.title: Grain reveal
items.description: A generated image gathers from grains of its own colours, centre first, and locks sharp. Sand away, in reverse.

items.name: film-develop
items.title: Film develop
items.description: A generated image comes up like a print in the tray: a soft field of its colours, then pools of focus opening through it.

items.name: reeded-reveal
items.title: Reeded reveal
items.description: A generated image seen through reeded glass: each reed bends its slice, then the glass clears from the centre outward.

items.name: variant-pick
items.title: Variant pick
items.description: Keep one of a batch of generations: your save runs, the others blow away in their own colours, and the one you kept grows into the space.

items.name: inpaint-brush
items.title: Inpaint brush
items.description: Paint over what to change: the pixels lift away as grains, Fill sends your API a real mask, and the result fills in through the hole.

items.name: image-viewer
items.title: Image viewer
items.description: Wrap the grid you already have: a thumbnail grows into the full view, zooms where you aim, and shrinks back into its hole when you close.

items.name: image-crop
items.title: Image crop
items.description: Frame a photo to any aspect and straighten it with a dial: the photo zooms itself just enough that no corner ever shows empty.

items.name: sand-away
items.title: Sand away
items.description: One call on any element: a front crosses it and every grain it reaches blows away in the picture’s own colours. undoAway() blows it back.

items.name: burn-away
items.title: Burn away
items.description: One call for the delete that is final: a glowing edge eats across the element and every grain rises as an ember.

items.name: shatter-away
items.title: Shatter away
items.description: One call to discard: the element cracks into shards that kick outward and drop, bottom first.

items.name: drain-away
items.title: Drain away
items.description: One call for a move: the element’s edges let go first and everything spirals into its own centre, as if it went somewhere.

items.name: clear-to-dust
items.title: Clear to dust
items.description: One call before you clear a field: its text lifts away left to right as fine dust in its own colour, in under half a second.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The base action: variants, 24–40px sizes, a 3% press, and status (pending, success, error) shown through an icon slot and a morphing label.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: Connected actions on one surface: a selection fill that is thrown to the segment you pick, dividers that fade beside it, labels that fold into icons when narrow.

items.name: split-button
items.title: Split button
items.description: Dual-action trigger: primary action on the left, trailing chevron on the right opening an aligned dropdown menu.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: Copies on the press: the icon blurs into a self-drawing check, the label morphs to Copied, and a failed copy shakes and says so.

items.name: action-button
items.title: Action button
items.description: A button that runs a promise and shows it: the icon slot opens for a spinner, a check draws itself, failures shake, and the label morphs through each.

items.name: expanding-button-group
items.title: Expanding button group
items.description: Icon toolbar where the action you point at, tab to or tap opens its label while neighbours slide aside, with ask-first and done states in place.

items.name: floating-button-group
items.title: Floating button group
items.description: Floating canvas toolbar: one indicator thrown to the active tool, a zoom stepper whose value rolls, and a menu that grows out of its chevron.

items.name: icon-morph
items.title: Icon morph
items.description: One icon becoming another: blur pop, direction-aware turn, card flip, or strokes that draw themselves. Fast toggling never jumps.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A one-line field with a label, hint and error that trade places, a clear button that folds in, and one shake when an error arrives.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A text box that eases to the height of what you write, scrolls with its own thin thumb and faded edges, and turns into a composer with tools, a send button and ⌘↵.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password input
items.description: A password field with an eye that turns into eye-off, a four-step strength meter that fills and names itself, and a Caps Lock warning.

items.name: search-input
items.title: Search input
items.description: The field at the top of every list: ⌘K focuses it from anywhere, search runs after a pause, the magnifier blurs into a spinner while it loads.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A choice from a list that is never the browser's dropdown: the pill grows into its list and folds back as the label morphs.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: Multi-select
items.description: Several choices from a short list: the pill names them ("Design, Sales +2"), the list rises off it with ticks that draw, and it stays open while you pick.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: One date, typed or picked: the field reads "tomorrow", "next fri" or "4 nov", and the calendar slides by month while one mark glides between days.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: Time picker
items.description: Type “9:30 pm” or fling the hour, minute and AM/PM drums; both paths settle into one plain HH:mm value.

items.name: timezone-picker
items.title: Timezone picker
items.description: A searchable IANA timezone picker with live local clocks, exact UTC offset deltas, a spring-driven 24-hour daylight hairline and one-click Detect.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A real checkbox whose fill grows from the centre and whose tick draws itself, with a mixed state that bends into the tick.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: One choice from a few: the dot pops into the new circle, or, as cards, one selection frame glides from card to card.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A switch with weight: the thumb stretches on press, is thrown across with a slight overshoot, and spins while an async save settles.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: One value or a range: a press throws the nearest thumb there, a drag tracks the finger, and the value rises out of the thumb.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color picker
items.description: A colour field with a real saturation surface, kinetic hue and opacity rails, typed hex, RGB or HSL, and swatches that stay in sync.

items.name: currency-input
items.title: Currency input
items.description: A locale-aware money field with caret-safe typing, currency formatting, keyboard steps and clean numeric values for your backend.

items.name: phone-input
items.title: Phone input
items.description: An international hairline phone input with searchable calling codes, caret-safe national formatting, automatic +E.164 country detection and structured output.

items.name: credit-card-input
items.title: Credit card input
items.description: A single-line hairline card composer with live Visa, Mastercard, Amex and Discover detection, 3D CVC back-stripe flip, Luhn validation and seamless field handoff.

items.name: rating-input
items.title: Rating input
items.description: Whole or half-star ratings with hover previews, rolling values and native radio behaviour for keyboards, forms and screen readers.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: One of a few options side by side: the thumb is thrown to the new segment while its width eases to the new label.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A name and shortcut for an icon. The first one waits; after that they glide from trigger to trigger like one label travelling along the toolbar.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A small panel that belongs to a button: it rises off the trigger from the nearest point, flips to fit, and hands focus to what is inside.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover card
items.description: A preview of what a link points to: it rises off the link after a rest, stays open while you move onto it, and closes after a short grace.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: Actions behind a button: the menu rises off the trigger, one highlight glides between rows, and checkbox rows draw their tick in place.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context menu
items.description: Actions where you right-click: the menu grows from the exact point, a long press opens it on touch, and Shift+F10 from the keyboard.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A decision that needs the whole screen: the page fades back under a veil of its own colour and the panel rises out of a blur.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge and can be thrown back: drag it toward its edge and release speed decides whether it closes.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A status, a tag or a count: statuses ease their colour and morph their word, live dots breathe, counts roll and fold away at zero.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A face, or initials until there is one: the photo rises out of a blur once it has loaded, and a stack of avatars fans open when you point at it.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Something is happening: a ring with one sweeping arc, three rising dots, or eight petals fading round, in currentColor.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: How far along, as a bar or a ring: the fill eases to each value, the percent rolls, and at 100 it turns green and a check draws itself.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: The shape of what's coming, with one soft band of light sweeping across, and a swap that hands over to the real content without a pop.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: What a list says before there is anything in it: an isometric line drawing in your theme that draws itself, changes with the state and acts out the action.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A message that sits in the page: its tint, line and icon ease when the tone changes, and dismissing folds it away so the content below slides up.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard shortcut written for the reader's keyboard (⌘ on a Mac, Ctrl elsewhere) whose keys sink when you press them for real.

items.name: shortcut-sheet
items.title: Shortcut sheet
items.description: A searchable keyboard shortcuts reference and modal with live physical keycap lighting, chord and sequence matching and OS-aware glyphs.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Views of one thing: the underline or pill is thrown to the new tab, the panel slides in from the side you moved toward, and counts roll.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Sections that open in place: the height eases open, the content rises out of a blur a beat later, and opening one folds the other at the same time.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: "Show 4 more" that opens in place: the hidden part eases open through a blur while the button's words morph to "Show less".

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Where you are and the way back: a long trail folds its middle into "…", which opens the hidden crumbs in place one after another.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Pages of a long list: the current-page mark is thrown to the new number, and in a narrow container it becomes "3 of 12" with a number that rolls.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: On/off choices side by side whose fills merge: two pressed toggles next to each other square off their inner corners and read as one shape.

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: Where you are in a flow: the line to the next step fills along its length, the finished number blurs into a drawn check, and phones get "Step 2 of 4".

items.name: text-morph
items.title: Text morph
items.description: Text that changes the way it should: shared letters slide over, new ones rise out of a blur, the width eases.

items.name: status-button
items.title: Status button
items.description: Save, Saving, Saved: the spinner opens in, the check draws itself, errors shake, and the label morphs between them.

items.name: number-roll
items.title: Number roll
items.description: Numbers that change like an odometer: every digit rolls in the direction the number moved.

items.name: pricing-toggle
items.title: Pricing toggle
items.description: Monthly or yearly: the thumb slides with a little give, and every price on the page rolls to its new amount.

items.name: waitlist-field
items.title: Waitlist field
items.description: An email field that becomes its own answer: the button stretches across it, then settles as "You’re on the list · #1,248".

items.name: code-input
items.title: Code input
items.description: The six boxes, done properly: digits rise in, a paste cascades, a wrong code shakes and clears, the right one becomes a pill with a check.

items.name: steps-form
items.title: Steps form
items.description: A multi-step form in one card that changes shape: steps slide in from the way you’re going, checks shake and explain, and Create turns into what comes next.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date range picker
items.description: A range is one liquid band: it follows your pointer between days, presets flow it to their span, and the dates morph as it moves.

items.name: morphing-nav
items.title: Morphing nav
items.description: One dropdown that follows you along the menu, gliding and resizing to each item’s content.

items.name: feature-tabs
items.title: Feature tabs
items.description: One panel, many features: the line slides between tabs, fills as autoplay runs, and the panel eases to each.

items.name: scroll-story
items.title: Scroll story
items.description: A how-it-works section that tells itself as you scroll: steps light up at the middle, a rail fills, and one card reshapes into each step’s picture.

items.name: stats-band
items.title: Stats band
items.description: Numbers that arrive when you do: hairlines draw themselves, then each figure rolls up from zero in turn.

items.name: announcement-pill
items.title: Announcement pill
items.description: "New: …" above your headline that opens into the news: the pill itself grows into a changelog card.

items.name: testimonials
items.title: Testimonials
items.description: One quote, chosen by its people: faces step forward, the words cross-fade through a blur, a ring keeps time.

items.name: faq-accordion
items.title: FAQ accordion
items.description: Questions on hairlines that open like they mean it: the answer eases to its height, the plus folds into a minus.

items.name: logo-marquee
items.title: Logo marquee
items.description: A quiet strip of logos that notices you: it eases to a stop on hover and the logo you point at stays bright.

items.name: expanding-gallery
items.title: Expanding gallery
items.description: An image opens from its exact place in the grid, becomes a spacious viewer, and finds its way back.

items.name: card-deck
items.title: Card deck
items.description: A tactile stack that fans out, follows your hand, and deals the next card with a measured flick.

items.name: workflow-canvas
items.title: Workflow canvas
items.description: Connected steps you can move, inspect and follow as work flows through them.

items.name: image-compare
items.title: Image compare
items.description: Two images, one precise divide. Drag to reveal what changed, then let the handle settle.

items.name: magnifying-dock
items.title: Magnifying dock
items.description: A dock that makes room for the tool you reach for, then opens it in place.

items.name: hold-to-confirm
items.title: Hold to confirm
items.description: A deliberate action, held for a moment: the ring fills, the label changes, and confirmation settles into a check.

items.name: swipe-actions
items.title: Swipe actions
items.description: A list row that slides over its actions: cells grow with your finger, a full swipe runs the first one, and the row folds away.

items.name: drop-zone
items.title: Drop zone
items.description: A considered file uploader. Clear actions, quiet progress and useful feedback.

items.name: drop-zone-membrane
items.title: Drop zone · Membrane
items.description: A drop zone whose border is a membrane: it reaches for the file, holds it, swallows it and passes it through to its row.

items.name: wheel-picker
items.title: Wheel picker
items.description: Drums you can fling: each column is a real cylinder that decays onto a row, with a lens in full colour over the middle.

items.name: morphing-chart
items.title: Morphing chart
items.description: Bars, line and area as one set of marks: bars condense into beads, a thread is strung through them, the fill pours down. Drag the switch to scrub it.

items.name: range-ruler
items.title: Range ruler
items.description: Two hairline needles across a graduated scale. Thumbs glide without layout thrash and repel each other on contact.

items.name: ratio-balancer
items.title: Ratio balancer
items.description: A multi-segment allocation track. Drag dividers to rebalance constrained percentages with zero initial jump.

items.name: split-pane
items.title: Split pane
items.description: A desktop-grade resizable dual panel. Zero-lag drag, rubber-band spring limits, and double-click preset snapping.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag input
items.description: The invite field, done properly: typed letters grow a chip round themselves, pasted lists spill out of the caret, and a duplicate flies into its twin.

items.name: avatar-cropper
items.title: Avatar cropper
items.description: The profile photo field without a modal: the avatar itself grows into the crop, and shrinks back with the face you framed.

items.name: week-calendar
items.title: Week calendar
items.description: A scheduling week you hold in the hand: drag a slot into an event while its times roll, and anything it lands on eases aside.

items.name: inline-edit
items.title: Inline edit
items.description: Rename a title, a project or a row where it stands: the text becomes the field without moving a pixel, and saves itself.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Pick one or several from a list your server searches: results morph between queries instead of flashing, and picks fly into chips.

items.name: cron-input
items.title: Cron input
items.description: A schedule field people can read: cron or plain English in, the meaning in words and the next runs out, with clock changes flagged.

items.name: time-range-picker
items.title: Time range picker
items.description: "Last 15 minutes" for logs, metrics and traces: type 2h or yesterday 14:00–16:00, step by the window, pause live, or drag across a chart to zoom.

items.name: weekly-hours
items.title: Weekly hours
items.description: A recurring Mon to Sun operating and availability hours editor with split shifts, aligned 24-hour coverage bars, overlap guards and Copy to Mon-Fri.

items.name: json-inspector
items.title: JSON inspector
items.description: Read, search and quote a webhook payload or an API response, or see exactly what changed between two versions of a record.

items.name: stepper-input
items.title: Stepper input
items.description: A tactile incrementer: tap to step, hold to accelerate, bounds give an elastic bumper shake, and digits roll in place.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: An ultra-compact inline trendline with magnetic scrubber and auto-trend color for table cells and stat cards.

items.name: privacy-mask
items.title: Privacy mask
items.description: A frosted optical unmasker for sensitive keys, salaries and tokens, with auto-hide timeout and one-tap copy.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: A table whose rows travel: sort and every row glides to its rank, live data re-ranks itself, and selection turns the toolbar into its actions.

items.name: kanban-board
items.title: Kanban board
items.description: A pipeline you rearrange by hand: the card becomes the stage it's over while still in the air, and every column's total rolls as it passes.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter bar
items.description: The bar above a list, done like Linear’s: one panel from property to value, chips you change in place, and a sentence that becomes filters.

items.name: tree-view
items.title: Tree view
items.description: The sidebar of pages, folders or files: carry a row up, down and sideways to nest it, and folders open as you hold them.

items.name: doc-comments
items.title: Doc comments
items.description: Review threads beside the text they quote: the one you choose lines up with its line, and the rest make way.

items.name: api-keys
items.title: API keys
items.description: The API keys screen, done properly: the secret rises in once, and Done folds it down into the "sk_live_••••4f2a" it leaves behind.

items.name: env-editor
items.title: Env editor
items.description: A structured .env and secrets editor with multi-line .env bulk paste, automatic 8×8 Bayer secret veiling, copy-while-veiled, duplicate key checks and Prod/Prev/Dev scopes.

items.name: backup-codes
items.title: Backup codes
items.description: A 2FA recovery codes panel with 1.5px 8×8 Bayer secret veiling, copy-while-veiled, .txt export, used-code audit stamps and inline regeneration.

items.name: ip-allowlist
items.title: IP allowlist
items.description: A CIDR and firewall allowlist editor with IPv4/IPv6 validation, live subnet host counts, wildcard exposure guards, containment checks and bulk paste.

items.name: team-members
items.title: Team members
items.description: Settings → Members, done properly: invited addresses fly out of the field onto their rows, role pills grow into the list of roles, and seats roll.

items.name: settings-form
items.title: Settings form
items.description: A settings page that saves the way people expect: switches save themselves, text edits gather into one bar that rises with "2 unsaved changes".

items.name: auth-card
items.title: Auth card
items.description: Sign-in that asks one thing at a time: the email field shrinks into a chip round the address, and your server decides whether a password, a code or a link comes next.

items.name: sudo-gate
items.title: Sudo gate
items.description: Wrap any dangerous button. A padlock on its corner shows how long you stay verified; when it’s locked, the button grows right where it stands into the “Confirm it’s you” card.

items.name: webhooks
items.title: Webhooks
items.description: Settings → Webhooks, done properly: "Send test" runs a bead down the wire to the endpoint and back in the answer's colour, and every delivery opens into its request and response.

items.name: domain-connect
items.title: Domain connect
items.description: A custom domain from typed to live: copyable records that tick green as DNS finds them, checks that wait longer each time, and a rail that runs to Live.

items.name: log-stream
items.title: Log stream
items.description: A live tail you can actually read: scroll up and it lets go while a "↓ 128 new" pill counts what arrives, with pause, level counts, search and lines that open into their fields.

items.name: job-queue
items.title: Job queue
items.description: A worker pool’s jobs grouped by what needs you: reviews first, each job’s status ring doubling as its clock, approvals and retries that call your server.

items.name: csv-import
items.title: CSV import
items.description: Contacts → Import, done properly: your file's columns thread themselves to your fields, bad cells become fields you fix in place, and the rows go to your server in batches.

items.name: notification-inbox
items.title: Notification inbox
items.description: The bell, done properly: its own circle grows into the inbox, new notifications swing it and roll the count, and read ones fold out of Unread.

items.name: integrations
items.title: Integrations
items.description: Settings → Integrations, done properly: Connect waits on the provider's own window, then folds away as the account it connected opens in its place.

items.name: status-bars
items.title: Status bars
items.description: A status page that reads at a glance: ninety days a service drawn up bar by bar, one card that glides between them, and incidents whose updates open in as they're posted.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command palette
items.description: ⌘K that grows out of the search pill: fuzzy search, nested lists, and commands that run in place.

items.name: toast-stack
items.title: Toast stack
items.description: Notifications with continuous squircle geometry that stack, fan out on hover, follow a promise in one toast, and swipe away.

items.name: live-activity
items.title: Live activity
items.description: One pill for whatever is happening now: it updates in place, tap it and it grows into a panel, done blurs into a check.

items.name: live-cursors
items.title: Live cursors
items.description: Other people’s cursors gliding over the same page: names that turn into speech bubbles, click ripples, and selections that follow them around.

items.name: live-map
items.title: Live map
items.description: The world as dots, lighting up where things happen: pings ripple, the light lingers, and one card follows the newest event from city to city.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme toggle
items.description: The sun sets into a moon, and the new theme spreads from the button in a circle.

items.name: pricing-calculator
items.title: Pricing calculator
items.description: Drag to your size and watch the price roll, the plan morph and, at the top, “Let’s talk”.

items.name: comparison-table
items.title: Comparison table
items.description: Plans side by side, with a column that glides to the plan under your pointer and prices that roll.

items.name: onboarding-checklist
items.title: Onboarding checklist
items.description: The first five things, ticked off in place: a ring that fills, checks that draw, and a finish worth seeing.

items.name: sortable-list
items.title: Sortable list
items.description: Drag to reorder and everything moves: rows slide out of the way, the dropped one settles, every rank rolls, and presets re-sort the lot.

items.name: changelog-timeline
items.title: Changelog timeline
items.description: What shipped, drawn as you read: a rail that fills, dots that light, filters that fold the rest away.

items.name: changelog-trace
items.title: Changelog trace
items.description: What shipped, routed like a circuit: the line steps aside between releases, and a bead runs down it as you read.

items.name: changelog-scrubber
items.title: Changelog scrubber
items.description: Your release history on a ruler you scrub: drag the playhead, or press play and watch the product ship.

items.name: cookie-banner
items.title: Cookie banner
items.description: Asks once, plainly, then folds into a small cookie button in the corner that grows back into the preferences.

items.name: newsletter-footer
items.title: Newsletter footer
items.description: A footer that’s still alive: a signup that becomes its own confirmation, drawn link underlines and your name in outline.

items.name: prompt-composer
items.title: Prompt composer
items.description: The input that starts it all: grows as you type, takes files, and turns Send into Stop while answering.

items.name: agent-composer
items.title: Agent composer
items.description: The taller composer for agent surfaces: branch, folder and context on a tab above, permissions and model as pills that grow into their lists.

items.name: mention-menu
items.title: Mentions and commands
items.description: Type @ to pull in context or / for a command. The menu grows from the caret and your text becomes a chip.

items.name: attachment-chip
items.title: Attachment chip
items.description: A file on its way into a prompt: uploading, being read, ready or failed.

items.name: mode-switcher
items.title: Mode switcher
items.description: Fast, Thinking, Research: a segmented switch with a sliding pill and locked paid modes.

items.name: model-picker
items.title: Model picker
items.description: The model pill in your composer grows into the menu: what each model is for, speed, smarts and thinking effort.

items.name: voice-input
items.title: Voice input
items.description: Dictate a prompt: a waveform from your real mic level, a timer, then transcribing.

items.name: voice-note
items.title: Voice note
items.description: A voice message you can scrub and read along with: the waveform fills, the time rolls, and the transcript highlights each word as it’s said.

items.name: thinking-indicator
items.title: Thinking indicator
items.description: Four quiet loaders for the gap before the first token, with a label, a rolling timer and a finish that draws itself.

items.name: thinking-trace
items.title: Thinking trace
items.description: An expandable record of what an agent did: steps, reasoning, search or tool calls.

items.name: tool-call
items.title: Tool call
items.description: One tool invocation from arguments to result: preparing, running, done, failed or denied.

items.name: clarifying-question
items.title: Clarifying question
items.description: The agent pauses to ask. Pick with a click or a number key, or type your own; it folds into a one-line receipt.

items.name: approval-card
items.title: Approval card
items.description: The agent asks before it acts: what it wants to do, the details, Approve or Deny.

items.name: plan
items.title: Plan
items.description: An agent’s checklist that ticks itself off: pending, in progress, done, skipped or failed.

items.name: web-research
items.title: Web research
items.description: Watch the agent search: the query types in, page icons stack up as it reads, then it folds into a trail of searches and the pages each one found.

items.name: command-output
items.title: Command output
items.description: A command the agent runs: the log streams in, folds away on success, and stays open on failure.

items.name: task-progress
items.title: Task progress
items.description: For work that takes minutes: phases, a live timer, stats, cancel, and the result when it’s done.

items.name: task-log
items.title: Task log
items.description: What the agent did, task by task, as it does it: steps arrive on a hairline trail, files sit in chips, titles turn past tense.

items.name: streaming-answer
items.title: Streaming answer
items.description: An answer as it arrives, with inline citations, actions, sources and follow-ups.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: Code in an answer: highlighted as it streams, copy and wrap, long files folded, and an optional Apply.

items.name: citation
items.title: Citation
items.description: An inline numbered source that previews the site, title and snippet on hover or focus.

items.name: response-versions
items.title: Response versions
items.description: Step between regenerated answers with "2 / 3", and regenerate without losing the old ones.

items.name: selection-actions
items.title: Selection actions
items.description: Select text and a pill appears under it. Pick an action or describe an edit, and the rewrite streams in place.

items.name: inline-rewrite
items.title: Inline rewrite
items.description: Drag a dial and the paragraph rewrites itself in place: shared words glide, the rest blur out and rise in.

items.name: diff-review
items.title: Diff review
items.description: Accept or reject what the AI changed, word by word for prose or line by line for code.

items.name: action-receipt
items.title: Action receipts
items.description: What the agent actually did, one quiet line each, with Undo while a ring drains. Several stack into one.

items.name: chat-notice
items.title: Error and limit states
items.description: Calm, specific notices for failed answers, being offline, rate limits and chats that grow too long.

items.name: usage-meter
items.title: Usage meter
items.description: Credits, messages or context left: quiet when there’s plenty, clear before it runs out.

items.name: usage-limits
items.title: Usage limits
items.description: What an agent has left: the context window split by what fills it, and each plan limit with its share and a live reset countdown.

items.name: chat-scroll
items.title: Jump to latest
items.description: A chat that follows the answer as it streams, lets go the moment you scroll up, and brings you back.

items.name: message-edit
items.title: Edit and resend
items.description: Fix a sent message where it sits. The bubble grows into an editor, then folds back and branches the reply.

items.name: chat-history
items.title: Chat history
items.description: Past chats grouped by day, searchable, with titles that write themselves, rename in place and delete with Undo.

items.name: earnings-chart
items.title: Earnings chart
items.description: A bar chart that changes instead of redrawing: bars glide between periods, the scale and the total roll, a readout follows the pointer.

items.name: steps-chart
items.title: Steps chart
items.description: A week against a daily goal: days that make it fill in, a wave runs the way you step through the weeks, the totals roll.

items.name: revenue-chart
items.title: Revenue chart
items.description: This year as an area, last year behind it; point at a month and the header becomes the readout, switch the measure and the lines reshape.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area chart
items.description: Several series stacked, overlapping or as shares: every band morphs between layouts, and the tiles are the legend, the switches and the readout.

items.name: trend-chart
items.title: Trend chart
items.description: One metric over time, the way an analytics screen needs it: the period before as a dashed line, an unfinished day drawn dashed, a readout that glides with the pointer, and drag to zoom.

items.name: combo-chart
items.title: Combo chart
items.description: Every day as a bar and the trend as a line on one scale: point at a day and the header becomes its readout while the line’s dot pings where it lands.

items.name: stage-bars
items.title: Stage bars
items.description: A funnel you can read at a glance: every stage as a bar against the first, the drop-off between them, and widths that ease when the period changes.

items.name: activity-rings
items.title: Activity rings
items.description: Three daily goals as concentric rings beside a tight legend, with the week underneath: pick a day and the rings sweep to it.

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: Donut chart
items.description: Parts of a whole as a ring or a half-ring gauge: point at a slice and the centre rolls to it, hide one and the rest slide round.

items.name: activity-heatmap
items.title: Activity heatmap
items.description: Every day as a square, weeks across: one readout glides to the day you point at, and new numbers ripple through week by week.

items.name: live-line-chart
items.title: Live line chart
items.description: One metric as it happens: each point slides in at an even pace, the scale eases, and a Live pill pauses the view.

items.name: agent-playback
items.title: Agent playback
items.description: Your AI product working, hands-off and on a loop: the hero demo built from the real components.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: The app sidebar, ready to use: workspace switcher, search, counts, groups and account. Drag its edge to resize it or fold it into a rail where no icon moves.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page header
items.description: The top of every app page: breadcrumbs, title, status, actions and tabs. As you scroll, the title glides up and shrinks into a sticky bar.

items.name: wallet
items.title: Wallet
items.description: A balance you can send from: the balance panel turns into the transfer, the button goes Sending → Sent, and the money visibly leaves.

items.name: convert
items.title: Convert
items.description: A two-sided exchange block joined by a live rate hairline that shortens from both ends as the quote ages, re-quotes in place with delta and snaps taut on lock.

items.name: pricing-plans
items.title: Pricing plans
items.description: Plans that turn into their own checkout: pick one and its card becomes the order, seats and totals rolling, then Continue opens your checkout.

items.name: booking
items.title: Booking
items.description: Book a call on one card: the time you pick prints onto the host’s ticket, then the times turn into your details and the confirmation.

items.name: cart
items.title: Cart
items.description: A cart whose receipt does the maths in front of you: codes are stamped on, a rail of light fills toward free shipping and every total rolls.

items.name: referral
items.title: Referral
items.description: A referral pass that fills as friends join: their faces fly up into its notches, and the last one turns the track into Claim.

items.name: feedback
items.title: Feedback
items.description: A score that changes the question: pick 0–10 or stars, the score rolls into the panel, and the follow-up and its tags fit what you picked.

items.name: buy-box
items.title: Buy box
items.description: A product buy box whose swatches repaint the product: pick a colour and size, and Add to bag throws the product into the bag.

items.name: checkout
items.title: Checkout
items.description: A one-page checkout whose steps stack into a receipt: contact, address, delivery and your payment element, then Place order turns into the order number.

items.name: order-status
items.title: Order status
items.description: An order’s route with a parcel riding it: stops light as it passes, the arrival day rolls, and the carrier’s scans slide in.

items.name: subscription
items.title: Subscription
items.description: A billing page in one card: the plan with a ring through its billing period, usage, card and invoices, and a cancel that offers a pause first.

items.name: file-share
items.title: File share
items.description: Drop files, watch them upload, and they fold into one share link with an expiry and an optional password.

items.name: poll
items.title: Poll
items.description: A poll whose bars race to their share: vote, and every option fills with light while the percentages roll and live votes keep nudging them.

items.name: cookie-consent
items.title: Cookie consent
items.description: A cookie banner with a mascot: every cookie you allow flies to Crumb, who catches it, nibbles it and gets rounder and happier.

items.name: create-password
items.title: Create password
items.description: A password step with a chameleon: the stronger the password, the better Hide blends in, until only his eye is left.

items.name: verify-code
items.title: Verify code
items.description: A one-time code step with a carrier pigeon: Coo naps through the resend wait with the seconds in a thought bubble, and flies every new code to your mailbox.

items.name: delete-workspace
items.title: Delete workspace
items.description: A danger-zone delete with a ghost: as you type the name, Boo climbs out of the workspace’s tile, and holding Delete waves him off the stage.

items.name: terms
items.title: Terms
items.description: A terms-of-service step with an owl who reads along: Skim sums up each section in one plain line, gets dizzy if you scroll too fast, and gives a thumbs up at the end.

items.name: not-found
items.title: Not found
items.description: A 404 with a search and a puppy: Fetch sniffs as you type, sprints off to fetch the results and comes back with a newspaper, or a stick.

items.name: waitlist
items.title: Waitlist
items.description: A waitlist that is an actual line: you step in at the end with your number over your head, and every friend who joins lets you hop past the person ahead.

items.name: storage
items.title: Storage
items.description: A storage meter with a raccoon and his suitcase: near the limit the case bulges and Pack sits on it to shut it; clean up and he hops down, upgrade and a roomy trunk arrives.

items.name: username
items.title: Username
items.description: A username picker with a penguin holding a sign: your name appears on it as you type; if it’s taken, its smug owner slides in hugging a sign with your name on it.

items.name: task-card
items.title: Task card
items.description: Tasks on a textured tray in your colours: tick one and a line travels slowly through its name, the ink fading behind it, then done tasks glide below the open ones.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Tasks over days joined by what they wait for: drag one and the tasks behind it are pushed along on springs, their lines stretching like rubber bands.

items.name: seat-map
items.title: Seat map
items.description: Pick seats while other people are picking too: yours rise with your initials, and a seat taken under you turns over with a ripple and points to the next best.

items.name: leaderboard
items.title: Leaderboard
items.description: Where you stand and what it takes to move up: a line that fills as you close on the person above, and an overtake that swings out a lane to pass.

items.name: deck-hero
items.title: Deck hero
items.description: A hero for design studios and agencies, drawn as their design canvas: rulers, layout columns and the work as artboards a collaborator selects one by one.

items.name: cinema-hero
items.title: Cinema hero
items.description: A video-first hero: a film-leader countdown cuts to your film playing with subtitles, the screen lights the room, and a 35mm chapter strip scrubs and jumps through it.

items.name: metric-bento
items.title: Metric bento
items.description: A free three-cell analytics bento: headline numbers that roll when you change the period, a bar split into four channels and a live event list you can filter.

items.name: scale-pricing
items.title: Scale pricing
items.description: A pricing section that follows usage: drag the volume slider and every price rolls, the right plan lights up and the comparison table opens below.

items.name: console-pricing
items.title: Console pricing
items.description: A dark-room hardware pricing configurator: three sculpted workload faders with LED bargraphs on the left mechanically wired into high-contrast plan slabs on the right.

items.name: ledger-pricing
items.title: Ledger pricing
items.description: A free Swiss architectural pricing section with three flush ruled columns, solid-ink inversion on the featured tier and a mechanical Monthly/Annual switch.

items.name: integration-beam
items.title: Integration beam
items.description: An animated product scene: soft light pulses travel along curved beams from your inputs into your product and out to your destinations, with live reflow and interactive pause.

items.name: tide-footer
items.title: Tide footer
items.description: A footer drawn as one engraved seascape: your name rises out of the water and stands on the horizon, its reflection ripples under the pointer and every link sends a ring across the sea.

items.name: skyline-footer
items.title: Skyline footer
items.description: A footer set in a city at night, drawn on a 6px grid: the towers build up as it comes into view, windows come and go, and a click in the sky sends a plane across.

items.name: fluted-footer
items.title: Fluted footer
items.description: A footer that ends in a pane of reeded glass with your name behind it. Light drifts behind the flutes and turns toward the pointer.

items.name: ridge-footer
items.title: Ridge footer
items.description: A footer that ends in a range of mountains printed in dots, with your name standing among the peaks. The ridges part as the pointer moves.

items.name: monolith-footer
items.title: Monolith footer
items.description: A footer with your name machined into its foot as raised letters: bevelled, lit by one moving light, casting real shadows.

items.name: atlas-footer
items.title: Atlas footer
items.description: A footer that ends on the curve of a dotted globe, with your hubs marked and light running between them. Drag to spin it.
